content:
gabi: FYI - noticed duplicates in onboarding sample when token refresh and app retry coincide. small but reproducible in staging.

noah: logs?

gabi: short log:
```[2060001000] POST /items -> 401 token_expired
[2060001001] app: immediate retry
[2060001002] sdk: refresh attempt 1 -> 429
[2060001003] sdk: refresh attempt 2 -> 200
[2060001004] app: retry sends POST /items (no Idempotency-Key)
[2060001005] backend: item created twice
```

ria: same class of bug as earlier threads. root cause: two independent retries (app + sdk) and missing idempotency signal.

noah: short-term fixes for sample app: add Idempotency-Key on mutating calls and a tiny debounce (uniform jitter 100-300ms) before app-side retry.

gabi: implemented debounce in sample and it prevented duplicates in local runs.

ria: medium-term SDK changes: 1) align backoff defaults across sdks to full_jitter for token refresh 2) add opt-in short replay-guard window (e.g., 250ms) that suppresses SDK resend when same request hash seen recently 3) emit metric `sdk.replay_guard.suppressed` and log reasons.

noah: agree. important note: auto-idempotency must be weak and opt-in; strong idempotency requires app-provided keys. document parity flags: `refresh.backoff.strategy` and `sdk.enable_replay_guard`.

ops-bot: CI job queued for sample-app branch at 2060001100.

gabi: will open PRs for sample app and python sdk; thanks.

noah: add a platform detector to count duplicate creates within 1s window to catch regressions.

gabi: filed RW-5588 (sdk replay guard), RW-5589 (sample app debounce + docs), RW-5590 (platform duplicate detector). closing this thread.
